Hamstr 0.7.5 fixes desktop download failures, duplicate DRM replacements and playback preferences, and reduces unnecessary Android background work.

- Suggested songs replace their DRM-blocked download entry while preserving its playlist membership and position.
- Shuffle and repeat remain saved across songs, playlists and app restarts.
- Android pauses Nearby discovery, its multicast lock and decorative ambient motion in the background; music continues playing. Bluetooth settings observers are released when discovery stops.
- Desktop tool processes skip inaccessible Windows PATH directories. With Cheek selected, unsupported links can use its native resolver.
- Bundles cheek 0.3.0, the minor release for adaptive transfers, resumable range retries and independent fragment scheduling.

This is the intended bugfix version after 0.7.4. The incorrectly numbered 0.8.0 was withdrawn and 0.8.1 was canceled. Android's internal version code remains higher than the withdrawn build so manual installation preserves existing app data. If you installed 0.8.0, install 0.7.5 manually once because the old updater compares the visible version numbers.

Heat and battery improvements still require physical-device measurement. Desktop installers are not signed yet. Verify downloads against `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
